note: Every place tracked source names a Firestore document with an id the platform did not mint, and why (AGL-3079). Read by tools/scripts/check-id-minting.mjs, which is red for a site missing here, for a row no site matches, and for a list whose size is not ID_MINTING_CEILING in tools/scripts/lib/id-minting.mjs. This list may shrink and must never grow: a new document is named by createResourceUid(), or by a named key function where its id must mean something. RESOURCE rows are debts, each under the area issue that fixes it (to fix); RECORD rows are internal rows nobody addresses; DELIBERATE rows are keys whose meaning is the point. A row that only moved takes the new site.
